about: Deck pieces of Talal's SM_Airship that the rig build deletes (round 2, 2026-11-24: 'pointed items to be removed', 5 arrows on a top view of the ship). Island ids are the research classifier's (Docs/Airship/research/sm_airship_islands.json), Blender metres (+X bow, +Y port). Only the rig copy loses them; Talal's StylizedAirship.blend and the Unreal SM_Airship (physics body with UCX) are unchanged.
